function choose(...args: [{ x: number }] | [{ y: string }]): void { console.log(args); }
function keyed(...args: ['x', { x: number }] | ['y', { y: string }]): void { console.log(args); }
function padded(...args: [...number[], { info: { x: number } }]): void { console.log(args); }
choose({ x: 1, z: 2 });
choose({ x: 1, y: 'two' });
keyed('x', { x: 1, y: 'two' });
padded(0, 1, { info: { x: 1, z: 3 } });
padded(...[0, 1] as const, { info: { x: 1, z: 3 } });
padded(...[0, 1, { info: { x: 1, z: 3 } }] as const);
padded({ info: { x: 1, z: 3 } } as const);
function alternate(...args: [{ x: number }] | { y: string }[]): void { console.log(args); }
alternate({ y: 'a', z: 2 });
alternate({ y: 'a' }, { y: 'b', z: 2 });
